title: Investing in Merge Labs
summary: OpenAI is investing in Merge Labs to support new brain computer interfaces that bridge biological and artificial intelligence to maximize human ability, agency, and experience.
body: OpenAI is investing in Merge Labs to support new brain computer interfaces that bridge biological and artificial intelligence to maximize human ability, agency, and experience.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布投资Merge Labs，旨在支持脑机接口（BCI）技术的研发。该合作致力于构建生物智能与人工智能之间的桥梁，通过技术手段最大化人类的能力、代理权及交互体验。此举标志着OpenAI在探索通用人工智能（AGI）路径上，开始关注人机深度融合的硬件与接口层技术。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI投资脑机接口领域，显示其在生物智能与人工智能融合方向的战略布局。
